comment: I noticed my water usage had gone up significantly, but couldn’t find the leak in my system. I called Black Hill Landscaping to do an inspection of my irrigation system. They were able to come out first thing the next morning. John was really knowledgeable and was able to find the leak, but continued to check the rest of my system. I had someone who previously managed the irrigation system so I wasn’t too familiar with it myself. John walked me the through the settings on the console which I really appreciated. They were really upfront with pricing and affordable. I will definitely be using them anytime I need maintenance in the future.
draft_response: We really appreciate the kind words, Jaime. Knowing that the sprinkler and irrigation work went well for you in Fort Worth is exactly the kind of feedback that keeps our crew motivated. Thank you for trusting Black Hill Landscaping with your property.
